text:
zara-finance: Heads-up: Sable Therapeutics (private deploy) requested a midterm support tier downgrade effective 2026-08-02. We already posted platform fee on INV-110222 for full year. Customer asks for a single settlement number instead of reissue. Need final before renewal reminder on Monday.

liam-billing: Which SOW and reseller? Ill pull usage and compute proration.

zara-finance: SOW ST-9F. Reseller is NorthStar. Effective 2026-08-02. They prefer a credit memo they can apply to next renewal.

billing-bot: Metering export ready: /exports/sable_219045_batch.csv

billing-bot: CSV preview:
```
2026-07-01,platform_fee,1,96000
2026-07-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,6100,0
2026-08-02,change_event,1,0
```

aiofe-account: Numbers: EnterpriseUltra annual platform fee = $96,000. Pro tier = $54,000. Delta = $42,000. Remaining months from 2026-08-02 to 2027-01-01 ~ 5.96 months => prorate factor 0.4967. Prorated credit = 42,000 * 0.4967 = $20,865.

henry-cs: Customer asked to round down to avoid triggering partner commission clawback. They offered $20,800 as final.

mei-legal: We'll include settlement language: "This credit memo constitutes full and final settlement of platform fee differences arising from the 2026-08-02 support tier change under SOW ST-9F." Require finance lead sign-off and partner ops ack for commission handling.

oliver-partnerops: NorthStar will request commission protection. If the memo is marked "partner-approved settlement" we can waive clawback. Need partner ops sign-off email.

tera-cfo: I approve issuing a credit memo for $20,800 and the settlement language. Tera-cfo: signing off.

liam-billing: Creating credit memo CM-219045-01 for $20,800, status PendingPartnerAck. Notifying NorthStar and tagging AR to hold collections.

oliver-partnerops: Partner Ops acknowledges; NorthStar confirms no clawback on CM-219045-01. Sending internal confirmation now.

liam-billing: Partner ack received. Updating CM-219045-01 to Final and posting to AR. Collections: please apply to customer's account; do not reverse commissions.

zara-finance: I'll send the settlement PDF to Sable AP with subject "Final settlement of platform fee differential (SOW ST-9F)" and attach the partner waiver. Aoife, please attach to renewal thread.

aiofe-account: On it. Email staged and PDF attached. Customer replied: "Accepted, please apply to renewal."

liam-billing: Credit posted, AR updated, CM-219045-01 issued. Filing under SOW ST-9F and FO ticket FO-3366. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
